title: Moroccan Chicken Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tacos, this Moroccan-inspired recipe combines the flavors of Morocco with the comfort of a warm taco.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together cumin, coriander, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Add the chicken breast and toss to coat.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 6-7 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil.
In the same skillet, add the chickpeas and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cilantro and stir to combine.
Warm the tortillas on a dry skillet or in the microwave.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of chicken on each tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the chickpea mixture.
Drizzle with tahini and serve immediately.
